description: Agree the VERIFY BY section of the active feature log (flip Status: pending → agreed, set the Method). This is the MCP equivalent of the owner confirming the verify method in chat. Once agreed, the gated Pass can succeed. Call this once per feature after you and the AI agree how success will be tested.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

method.description: The agreed verify method text (e.g. 'run node scripts/smoke.cjs → 20 passed'). If omitted, existing methods are kept and only Status is flipped.

name: cpfs_agree_verify
